messages.subject: For Pol Le Roux | Rare earths, government relations and strategic-minerals execution
messages.body:
Dear Lynas Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pol Le Roux, Interim Chief Executive Officer.

Lynas' role in global rare-earths supply chains places government alignment, strategic-minerals policy, institutional credibility and disciplined stakeholder execution at the center of long-term growth. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today at the intersection of mining operations, public institutions and ESG.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior engagement with ministries, regulators, communities and industry stakeholders, translate external commitments into accountable operating owners, and coordinate complex issues across legal, environment, HSE, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around a significant solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Lynas' government-relations, strategic-minerals, stakeholder or international growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Lynas Rare Earths.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
